name: @smego/ui
description: SME.GO Marketplace React component library — WCAG 2.2 AA, Thai-first

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:css
scripts.build:fixture: npm run copy:fonts && esbuild tests/e2e/fixture/app.tsx --bundle --outfile=tests/e2e/fixture/app.js --loader:.tsx=tsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && tailwindcss -i tests/e2e/fixture/app.in.css -o tests/e2e/fixture/app.css
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:fixture && npm run gallery:build && playwright test
scripts.gallery:build: npm run copy:fonts && esbuild gallery/gallery.tsx --bundle --outfile=gallery/gallery.js --loader:.tsx=tsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' && tailwindcss -i gallery/gallery.in.css -o gallery/gallery.css
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run gallery:build && npm run check:fonts && npm run check:bundle && node ../02-tokens/validate-tokens.js && npm run build && npm run check:dist
scripts.verify:head: node ../02-tokens/verify-head.mjs
scripts.lint: node ../02-tokens/lint-classes.mjs && npm run lint:quality && npm run lint:parity && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:api-comments && npm run lint:rsc
